gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that {@link UtcInstant#durationUntil} accounts for the leap second on 1972-12-31, reporting a day length of 86401 seconds instead of the usual 86400.
ADDED i2: MJD 41682 = 1972-12-31, a day that contained a positive leap second (23:59:60)
ADDED i3: MJD 41683 = 1973-01-01, the day immediately after the leap second
ADDED i4: Start of the leap-second day (midnight at the beginning of 1972-12-31)
ADDED i5: Start of the following day (midnight at the beginning of 1973-01-01)
ADDED i6: A leap day spans 86401 seconds (86400 standard seconds + 1 leap second)
